thread:
erin: Rolling v2.15.0 canary->prod started at 08:15 UTC. Post-deploy smoke includes synth-rerank checks and embedding-consistency probes in us-east1 + eu-west1. Watch quality and p95.

deploy-bot: rollout started: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.15.0 mode=staggered postdeploy=rerank+embed-synth queued.

mike: heads up  eval-bot is reporting rerank-score drop in eu-west1 canary. baseline mean NDCG ~0.82 -> observed ~0.70 across synthetic set (50 samples). Not latency, this is ranking quality.

tara: can you paste the eval output? want to see which prompt families regressed.

mike: eval-bot: ```rerank-eval eu-west1 samples=50 ndcg_before=0.823 ndcg_after=0.703 delta=-0.120 affected_families=[support_faq, short-rewrite]```

erin: interesting — embedding-consistency probe also logged higher cosine variance for short prompts on same canary hosts. Might be quantization change in v2.15.0 that impacts small-context embeddings.

opsbot: embed-probe report: family=short prompts eu-west1 p95 cosine-dist=0.18 baseline=0.05 errors=0.

tara: Decision: pause remaining rollout. We'll pin eu-west1 routing back to v2.14.5 (last known good) to protect customers from rerank regressions. This is a quality regression, not infra. mike, run a route-pin dry run then apply. erin, update release notes with the quality rollback note.

mike: dry-run: `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.15.0 --to v2.14.5 --dry-run --reason "postdeploy rerank ndcg regression"`

deploy-bot: dry-run OK.

mike: applying pin now. `rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.15.0 --to v2.14.5 --reason "postdeploy rerank ndcg regression" --ticket QA-1289`

deploy-bot: action=route-pin status=applied service=inference-api region=eu-west1 pinned_to=v2.14.5 actor=mike ts=3300001162

eval-bot: re-run after pin: rerank-eval eu-west1 ndcg_restored=0.821 samples=50. embed-probe cosine-dist reverted to baseline.

erin: good. Action items: 1) hold global ramp for 2 hours 2) open follow-up ticket to investigate quantization/runtime change in v2.15.0 affecting short-context embeddings (assign to infra/rt + ml-research) 3) add release-note addendum documenting eu pin for quality regression 4) schedule targeted A/B test with controlled token-lengths and quant variants.

tara: I'll update release notes and the change window doc now, include the exact eval numbers and the pin rationale. :white_check_mark:

mike: creating follow-up ticket: INF-7782 (prod quality regression: v2.15.0 embedding variance on short prompts) and linking telemetry traces.

erin: threshold for incident: if rerank NDCG drop >0.1 across canary or customer-reported degradations increase >3x, escalate. For now we monitor.

opsbot: monitoring enabled: rerank-eval cadence=1m embed-probe cadence=30s alert_if_ndcg_drop=0.08.

erin: closing thread unless regression observed. Thanks all for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
